summary: Katara and Sokka crack open a glowing iceberg and find a cheerful airbender and his sky bison who have been frozen inside it for a hundred years.
Aang comes back to his old home and learns that his people are gone, and his grief sets off the Avatar State for the first time on screen.
The island's warriors capture the travelers, Sokka learns to respect Suki's fighting style, and Zuko's raid forces Aang to leave so the village is spared.
The king of Omashu sets Aang a series of strange trials, then reveals that he is Bumi, Aang's childhood friend.
Yue gives her life to restore the Moon Spirit, and Aang, joined with the Ocean Spirit, drives Admiral Zhao's fleet away from the city.
The group sneaks into Omashu after the Fire Nation takes it and helps its resistance, while Azula arrives to deal with the captive King Bumi.
The team finally reaches Ba Sing Se, only to find that the Dai Li forbid anyone from even mentioning the war.
The team reaches the Earth King and shows him the war his court has hidden from him, and Long Feng is arrested.
Azula takes control of the city with the Dai Li's help and strikes Aang down in the Avatar State, and Katara uses spirit water to bring him back.
Zuko comes home to the Fire Nation as a celebrated prince, but finds that getting back his old life doesn't settle his doubts.
Zuko, Azula, Mai and Ty Lee spend an awkward holiday on Ember Island that ends with each of them admitting something honest by a campfire.
The eclipse invasion falls apart because Azula was expecting it, while Zuko finally stands up to his father and leaves to join the Avatar.
The friends go to see a stage play about their own adventures and are uncomfortable with how the actors portray them.
Iroh and the Order of the White Lotus break through the city walls, using the comet's power, to take Ba Sing Se back.
With the war over, Zuko is crowned Fire Lord and promises to help the world recover.
